name: Poké Ball
description: A standard ball used to catch wild Pokémon.

name: Great Ball
description: A better ball with improved catch rate.

name: Ultra Ball
description: A premium ball with very high catch rate.

name: Safari Ball
description: A special ball used in the Safari Zone.

name: Net Ball
description: Better catch rate for Water and Bug types.

name: Premiere Ball
description: A rare commemorative ball.

name: Love Ball
description: Better catch rate if opposite gender.

name: Master Ball
description: The ultimate ball — guaranteed catch!

name: Potion
description: Restores 20 Condition to one Pokémon card.

name: Super Potion
description: Restores 40 Condition to one Pokémon card.

name: Hyper Potion
description: Restores 70 Condition to one Pokémon card.

name: Max Potion
description: Fully restores a Pokémon card's Condition.

name: Full Restore
description: Restores a Pokémon card to Mint Condition and heals status.

name: Antidote
description: Heals a poisoned Pokémon card.

name: Burn Heal
description: Heals a burned Pokémon card.

name: Ice Heal
description: Heals a frozen Pokémon card.

name: Awakening
description: Wakes a sleeping Pokémon card.

name: Paralyz Heal
description: Heals a paralyzed Pokémon card.

name: Full Heal
description: Heals all status conditions on a Pokémon card.

name: Red Apricorn
description: A red Apricorn. Can be crafted into a Level Ball.

name: Yellow Apricorn
description: A yellow Apricorn. Can be crafted into a Moon Ball.

name: Pink Apricorn
description: A pink Apricorn. Can be crafted into a Love Ball.

name: White Apricorn
description: A white Apricorn. Can be crafted into a Fast Ball.

name: Black Apricorn
description: A black Apricorn. Can be crafted into a Heavy Ball.

name: Old Rod
description: A basic fishing rod. Cast a line to find common Pokémon.

name: Good Rod
description: A decent fishing rod. Finds better Pokémon than the Old Rod.

name: Super Rod
description: The best fishing rod. Reels in powerful Pokémon.
